title: Confident at the moment of action: belief miscalibration in LLM play under hidden information
abstract: arXiv:2608.24691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate actions on a model's own stated confidence, which assumes confidence tracks correctness at the moment of acting. We test this in a hidden-information chess variant where royal status can be secretly, repeatedly relocated between pieces, and where an agent's stated probability distribution over the opponent's hidden royal piece -- elicited every turn, separately from the move it chooses -- is scored against ground truth recoverable after the game. Across two independent batches, captures made at high stated confidence ($\geq 0.5$) about the hidden piece's location were correct in 1 of 62 cases. The calibration deficit is concentrated almost entirely in these events: 99.3% of it in the original batch, 98.7% in the replication. translated_title: 行动时刻的自信：隐藏信息下LLM博弈中的信念校准失误
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24691v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代理系统越来越多地根据模型自身陈述的置信度来门控行动，这假设置信度在行动时刻能追踪正确性。我们在一种隐藏信息的国际象棋变体中对此进行了测试，其中皇家棋子的身份可以秘密地、重复地在棋子之间转移，并且代理对对手隐藏皇家棋子的陈述概率分布——每回合单独引出，与其选择的行动分开——会与游戏结束后可恢复的真实情况评分。在两个独立的批次中，在陈述高置信度（≥0.5）的情况下对隐藏棋子位置进行的捕获，在62例中仅1例正确。校准偏差几乎完全集中在这些事件中：原始批次中占99.3%，复制批次中占98.7%。同样的模式，以较弱的形式，在另外四个模型上一致排序（仅点估计；在此样本量下，大多数成对差异在统计上不可区分）。
tldr: 在隐藏信息博弈中，LLM在高置信度下的行动决策几乎完全错误，校准偏差集中于此，表明模型置信度在关键时刻严重失真。
en_tdlr: In hidden-information games, LLM actions made at high stated confidence are almost entirely incorrect, with calibration deficit concentrated in these events, revealing severe confidence distortion at critical decision moments.
